selection_rule: Rank candidates by (search demand / competition). Take the top N per week under the cadence ceiling. Never repeat a published question.

cadence.note: Ceiling is intentional. Never raised to clear a backlog.

admitted_domains: Marine geology, trenches, vents, seafloor mapping
Earth science: weather systems, climate mechanics, geology, volcanology
admitted_domain_ids_note: Maps loop/domains.py's `research/proposed-taxonomy.json` domain ids to their entry in admitted_domains above, so a validator can check 'is this running domain actually admitted' without guessing a name match. Only allocated domains need an entry here; see loop/config.json domains.allocation for what is actually running.
hard_exclusions: Medical, health, dietary, supplement or mental-health advice
Financial, investment, tax or legal advice
Named living private individuals as subject matter
Named companies framed critically in a way that invites defamation exposure
Active political controversy, elections, partisan framing
Religion framed as true or false
Conspiracy, cryptid, paranormal, or pseudoscience framed as real
Recent tragedy involving identifiable victims within 12 months
True crime involving identifiable victims or perpetrators
Anything requiring third-party footage that is not license-cleared
Dangerous acts, stunts, or anything replicable and harmful
content_rules: Every digit-bearing sentence maps to a named public source.
No claim of personal expertise, credentials, or professional advice.
Uncertainty and evidence limits stated explicitly where they exist.
One owner POV line per video, drawn from the POV bank. Never invented.
Structure rotated; no two consecutive videos share a shape.
All visuals originally generated or license-cleared with a rights-manifest entry.
escalation: A candidate that is admitted by domain but touches any exclusion is a NAMED STOP for owner review. It is never auto-published.
new_niche_requirement: Entering a domain outside 'Deep sea' requires a ~20 minute POV top-up interview before first publish, because tier:specific lines do not transfer.

amendments.change: Added 'Materials science and manufacturing' to admitted_domains and admitted_domain_ids['materials-and-manufacturing'].
amendments.why: Instruction: 'how-we-know: widen the channel from deep sea to deep sea + materials.' The loop had already been publishing materials-and-manufacturing episodes (allocated in loop/config.json domains.allocation, airing Mon/Fri since 2026-09-07) without the domain appearing in this standing admission — this amendment brings the record into agreement with what the pipeline was already doing.
amendments.new_niche_requirement_satisfied_by: The 2026-09-05 POV top-up interview (13 tier:specific lines in pov/pov-bank.json with domain materials-and-manufacturing).
